answer: Admit new identities only through a bonded lottery: each epoch opens a fixed number of slots, and bonded applicants are drawn by verifiable draw. A sybil farmer must post a bond for every puppet, yet most puppets sit unadmitted in the queue, so capital is locked while honest applicants also wait — the nadir of the queue is slow by design. Winning identities start in a mesa of limited rights, gaining full standing only after useful work, so a haven cannot be bought in bulk. Limits: lotteries delay honest onboarding, randomness must be verifiable, and wealthy attackers can still flood the draw.
